title: Wonderful accurate easy to use scale!
text: Wonderful accurate easy to use scale!. This is a great scale. I live on a farm where often we set up street side selling booths where I can sell mostly corn, cucumbers, carrots and strawberries. Normally a lot of what we do is portioned based on the bags we use other than the actual weight. I felt this was not the optimal way for us to try to sell things so when I saw this scale I couldn't wait to try it. First, it's rechargeable so it makes it easy to charge in the morning and then use throughout the day without having to plug it in. The display is large (wish it was a little better to use in the sunlight however, to minimize glare) and it is easy for me to see the weight and the cost. I highly recommend this for all smaller entrepreneurs (flea markets, roadside). Great asset for me, so glad I found this.

product_metadata.title: Bromech 66lb Digital Price Computing Scale, USB Rechargeable Commercial Food Meat Produce Scale with Large Single LCD Display, for Grocery Store, Roadside Stall, Type C Cable Included, Not for Trade
features: High Capacity: Capacity of 66lb, in increments of 0.02lb. This digital price computing scale can convert unit lbs to kgs and vice versa. It is a fast, affordable, and accurate way to weigh your popular items. Operation temperature: 0 to 40 °C (32 to 104°F)

Compact Design: With a small footprint (Size 11"Lx9.4" Wx3.1"H), this scale is easily portable so you can set it up on countertops and display cases without losing too much of your valuable space. Ideal for farmers' markets, grocery stores, meat shops, and more.
Convenient USB Charging: This price computing scale is powered by a built-in high-energy battery, which can use for several months when fully charged. Type C to USB cable included.
Easy-to-Read Display: Easy-to-read large single display (3.74" x 2.56") shows weight, unit price, and total price with give change function, which is convenient for both operator and customers.

Durable Construction: Robust HIPS plastic environmental protection material, which is shock-resistant and safe for foodstuff. This lightweight material (Product Weight -3.87 pounds ) is easy to carry and suitable for outdoor use, such as roadside stalls, Flea Market, produce stands.
